integrity: The analytic proof includes an exact entropy-derivative calculation and full initial-domain quantifiers; the reproducibility program is supplementary. Literature coverage is non-exhaustive; no independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Positive-infection, strictly interior susceptible strategy and w<1 only; positive partial-protection efficacy and transmission; strict mixed equilibrium inequalities. The statement is deterministic, homogeneous and concerns convergence and an integrated bound, not stochastic persistence or heterogeneous contacts.
title: Global mixed-endemic convergence with finite-rate evolutionary protection
